rules.statement: A purchaser from an assignee of an insolvent is considered a legal representative of the insolvent for the purposes of applying to set aside an order of abatement in a partition action.
rules.supporting_quote: "The cause of action appears to me to be the right of the plaintiff to have the land divided between himself and the co-owners, and the cause of action is the same in this suit. No authority has been brought to our notice to show that a purchaser from an assignee is not to legal representative of an insolvent."
